getRoleAdmin(bytes32).details: Returns the admin role that controls `role`. See {grantRole} and {revokeRole}. To change a role's admin, use {_setRoleAdmin}.

paused().details: Returns true if the contract is paused, and false otherwise.

proxiableUUID().details: Implementation of the ERC1822 {proxiableUUID} function. This returns the storage slot used by the implementation. It is used to validate the implementation's compatibility when performing an upgrade. IMPORTANT: A proxy pointing at a proxiable contract should not be considered proxiable itself, because this risks bricking a proxy that upgrades to it, by delegating to itself until out of gas. Thus it is critical that this function revert if invoked through a proxy. This is guaranteed by the `notDelegated` modifier.

reassignInvestmentNFTs(string,uint256[]).details: The destination is read from lenderWallet rather than passed in, so a token can only      ever land on the address the mapping already points at - there is no address argument      to get wrong. Each tokenId must belong to _lenderId; a mismatch reverts the whole call.      Tokens still escrowed by the PDN are rejected by managerTransfer, since those are      collected with claimLegacyInvestmentNFTs instead. Naming a token that already sits on      the destination also reverts, so batches must not overlap.

renounceRole(bytes32,address).details: Revokes `role` from the calling account. Roles are often managed via {grantRole} and {revokeRole}: this function's purpose is to provide a mechanism for accounts to lose their privileges if they are compromised (such as when a trusted device is misplaced). If the calling account had been revoked `role`, emits a {RoleRevoked} event. Requirements: - the caller must be `account`. May emit a {RoleRevoked} event.

setLenderPoolTokenId(string,string,uint2.details: Backfill path for legacy NFTs minted before mintLegacyInvestmentNFTBatch indexed them.      The token's own metadata must name the same lender/pool pair, so a pair can never be      pointed at an unrelated position. Passing token id zero clears the index, which is how      a pair is unindexed before its lender or pool record is deleted.

upgradeTo(address).details: Upgrade the implementation of the proxy to `newImplementation`. Calls {_authorizeUpgrade}. Emits an {Upgraded} event.

upgradeToAndCall(address,bytes).details: Upgrade the implementation of the proxy to `newImplementation`, and subsequently execute the function call encoded in `data`. Calls {_authorizeUpgrade}. Emits an {Upgraded} event.

reassignInvestmentNFTs(string,uint256[]).notice: Moves investment NFTs belonging to _lenderId onto that lender's currently         registered wallet. Callable by an edit manager or by the lender's own wallet.

setLenderPoolTokenId(string,string,uint2.notice: Points a lender/pool pair at an investment NFT that already exists.

updateLenderWallet(string,address).notice: Updates a lender's registered wallet. Any investment NFTs left at the old wallet         are moved separately, via reassignInvestmentNFTs.
